title: 水桶裡找洞
subject: a bicycle-shop mender who dunks inner tubes in a water bucket to find the leak by its bubbles, and the young man who comes back every afternoon at 4:30 with a tyre that has no puncture at all, on a bike he rents by the hour just to stand by her bucket
caption: Mandarin British music-hall singalong, brisk 2/4 pub stomp with a Taiwanese bicycle-shop setting. Upright piano pounding oom-pah left hand with bright right-hand fills, banjo-ukulele strumming a brisk 2/4 chop, plucked double bass on the beat, stomping boots and a rattling washboard. Dry crowded pub-stage mix, lively and slightly rough. Female lead, bright mid voice with a cheeky character delivery, clearly sung, a few friends shouting the chorus back in unison. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, C major. playful, cheeky, brisk mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM synths, no drum kit, no heavy distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - upright piano, banjo-ukulele, stomping boots]

[Verse 1]
每天下午四點半
他牽著腳踏車 到我車行
前輪軟軟的 他說沒氣了
我說 先放進水桶

[Pre-Chorus]
內胎壓進水裡 冒一串泡
哪裡漏氣 哪裡就唱歌

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡冒泡
哪個洞 哪個洞
輪胎沒破 氣門蓋鬆了
他的車胎 比他還會演

[Verse 2]
第二天 第三天 同一條胎
我貼上膠片 壓三下
他說好了嗎 我說早好了

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡不冒泡
沒有洞 沒有洞
輪胎沒破 是人慌了
我的水桶 他站最久

[Bridge - piano and stomping boots only]
他終於說 這輛車是租的
每天租一個鐘頭
就為了 來我桶邊站

[Chorus]
咕嚕咕嚕 水裡冒泡
這回有洞 這回有洞
我這顆心 沒人會補
咕嚕咕嚕 你來試試

[Outro - piano and banjo-ukulele, big stop]
明天四點半 換我帶水桶
